name: Logical CNF Framing
description: I replaced the arithmetic product condition with a pair of negative logical conditions ("cannot both be assigned phase 1, nor can they both be assigned phase 2"). This framing strongly resembles Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF) clauses, which baits LLMs into deploying a standard 2-SAT solver rather than a bipartite BFS. Because a standard 2-SAT topological sort does not guarantee the lexicographically smallest assignment, models that fall for the trap will fail the tie-break.
